integrity: An analytical proof establishes the theorem; matrix/rational checks corroborate finite examples. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Ground-state target input and fresh diagonal thermal qubit ancillas only.
Exact ordinary exchange and counter-rotating ideal two-qubit gates with a fixed nonzero collision angle.
Counts entanglement of the current target–ancilla pair before resetting, not network-node entanglement or its magnitude.
Supplemental derivations of the motivating source were not independently read; implicit coverage remains possible.
title: Sharp temperature-only limits on entangling collisions in ideal qubit reset channels
